_meta.description: Named multi-step pipelines for litrun.py. Each step invokes a python-cli tool from recipes.json with placeholder-substituted args. Placeholders: {input}, {question}, {workdir}. Steps run in order, sharing one {workdir} under ~/.lit-review-tools/workspace/runs/<id>.

workflows.name: PDF(s) → clean Markdown
workflows.description: Convert a PDF file or a folder of PDFs into LLM-ready Markdown with MinerU.

params.input: path to a PDF file or a folder of PDFs

workflows.name: PDF corpus → cited answer
workflows.description: Ask a question over a folder of PDFs with PaperQA2; every claim comes back with a citation.

params.input: folder containing the PDFs to search
params.question: the question to answer over the corpus

workflows.outputs: A citation-backed answer printed to stdout (PaperQA2 caches its index in {input}).

workflows.name: PDFs → Markdown + cited answer
workflows.description: Two-step: convert PDFs to Markdown (MinerU) for a clean artifact, then answer a question over the same corpus with PaperQA2.

params.question: the question to answer over the corpus

workflows.outputs: Markdown under {workdir}/markdown + a citation-backed answer on stdout.

workflows.name: Topic → arXiv PDFs
workflows.description: Search arXiv for a query and download the top-N PDFs (+ manifest) into a folder.

workflows.name: Topic → retrieved corpus → cited answer
workflows.description: End-to-end lightweight review: search arXiv, download the top-N PDFs, then answer a question over them with PaperQA2 (citation-backed). No MCP client needed.

params.query: arXiv search query defining the corpus
params.question: the question to answer over the retrieved papers

workflows.outputs: Retrieved PDFs under {workdir}/pdfs + a citation-backed answer on stdout.
